shots.line: What if the Sun just... disappeared? Right now. For the first eight minutes... you wouldn't notice a thing.
That's how long its last light takes to reach us. Then, like someone flipped a switch... the sky goes black.
The Moon goes dark too. It only ever shone with borrowed light. Now there are just stars. Everywhere.
And with nothing left to hold it, Earth stops circling... and flies off into space, in a perfectly straight line.
Within a week, the whole planet drops below freezing. Crops fail. And every plant on Earth stops making oxygen.
After one year, it's minus seventy three degrees. The oceans freeze over, from the top down.
But humans wouldn't vanish. Deep underground, warmed by the planet's own heat, a few of us could hold on... for thousands of years.
One tiny, warm light... drifting through the dark. Forever.
So the next time you see a sunrise... maybe say thanks.
